artifact: CityMETER Industrial Estate — map of Thailand's industrial estates, parks and zones (106 catalogue records of the industrial-estate research master, registry research.TH.industrial_estates, data contract industrial-estate-demo/1.0.0) with the 46 OpenStreetMap outlines the master selected, IEAT directory listings per estate, logos, and the CityMETER Factory registrations within 3 km of each outline
locationIntelligenceProfile: hash-verified only (location-intelligence-profile-lds-0.9.7-r1, sha256 5d4856041709735d3a04d4a510a88b551df86c211fdcab8a0707e8fe7c9efc3b): the estate fill is a total of the base count family (directory listings); no LI metric scale applies (no capacity, demand, catchment or density is drawn)
sharedWith: CityMETER Factory (same repository): theme, fonts, pictograms, cues, scales, massing, citymeter-shell 0.5.4

colors.applied: assets/theme.css (the Factory file) — foundation pairs, map roles, dataState, categorical series 1–10, count classes
colors.analytical: js/scales.js — LDS count, all 41 samples by rank among the measured listings of the drawn estates (buildRamp); identical HEX on both themes; an estate without a listing in this snapshot is EVID-05 no data (the hatch), never 0
colors.categorical: js/cues.js — the Factory industry families (series + shape) for the around-estate points and bars
colors.context: province lines and estate outlines in foundation colours; the open estate in --map-selected-stroke; logo plates on LDS surfaces (#20292D dark card, #FFFFFF light raised)

firstAha: share of the catalogue records in the three EEC provinces (Chachoengsao, Chon Buri, Rayong) by the source province label, each province as a link — a composition, never a ranking of estates (no ranking feature approved); with the IEAT directory listings of the EEC estates
countingUnit: records (รายการ) and IEAT directory listings (รายชื่อ) — never factories, tenants, companies or workers
geometryAndMetricContract: only the 46 outlines the master selected (DEMO_BOUNDARIES, OpenStreetMap snapshot 2026-10-25, ODbL 1.0); the other 60 records state why they have none; province = source label; around-estate set = Factory registrations with a published point ≤ 3 km from the outline (0 inside), a distance set for context
logos: LOGO_LIBRARY files whose SHA-256 equals logo_sha256 (27 display copies for 67 records); a caption says what the mark is (โลโก้นิคม · บริษัทแม่ · ผู้พัฒนา), short labels (owner 2026-11-10)
accessibility: visible focus on every control including the estate chips on the map
estate chips are buttons (keyboard and screen reader)
no-data hatch has a text label in the legend
privacy: directory names written as a natural person's are withheld (ผู้ประกอบการบุคคลธรรมดา) and never matched or sent to Google
